model: Grease Trapper ESP Kitchen Exhaust Pollution Control System v1.00
equipment_type: Kitchen exhaust pollution control unit (electrostatic precipitator)
applies_to: Accurex Grease Trapper ESP electrostatic kitchen exhaust pollution control units.
summary: The Grease Trapper ESP is an electrostatic pollution control unit for kitchen exhaust. Its controller offers a short BACnet MS/TP or BACnet IP list: exhaust fan speed, remote enable, fire status, wash enable and status, detergent level, door interlocks, fan fault and the power supply status of each pass.
notes: The points list states the mapping: Analog and Integer variables are Analog Value objects, Digital variables are Binary Value objects.
BV 106 Door Switches reads 1 when the doors are closed (OK) and 0 when a door is open.

source.title: Grease Trapper ESP Kitchen Exhaust Pollution Control System - Installation, Operation and Maintenance Manual, BMS Points List (v1.00)

integration.summary: Enable the unit with BV 101 Remote_Enable and start a wash with BV 103. Read BV 130 exhaust fan status, AV 20 fan speed and the pass power supply status, and alarm on BV 105 fan fault, BV 102 fire status and BV 104 low detergent.
integration.enable: BV 101 Remote_Enable starts the exhaust fan from the BMS; BV 103 enables the wash.
setup: BACnet MS/TP or BACnet IP needs the matching communication card in the controller serial card port, with BACnet Plugin set to YES.
Default device instance is 77000; MS/TP MAC, baud and IP settings are adjusted from the controller display (BACnet IP cards ship in DHCP mode).
gotchas: Network settings changed on the display only take effect after a Write on the BACnet Read/Write screen and a power cycle.
